opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Applications considered on a rolling basis.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission for academics in immediate danger, working with them to find temporary refuge in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK) until they can one day return home. Provides 2- or 3-year awards as standard, helping academics at risk to escape to a safe place to continue their work. Supports both those needing postgraduate qualifications such as a PhD and those already holding doctorates seeking postdoctoral placements.
